title: I can feel the coils. Good enough for a night or two guest mattress, but not as your every night bed.
text:
I can feel the coils. Good enough for a night or two guest mattress, but not as your every night bed.. Well... this is one of things where the old adage "you get what you pay for" definitely applies. This mattress is value priced for good reason. It's not terrible, but it's not something I want to sleep on more than a few hours at a time and certainly not on a regular basis. Nor would I ask anyone else to do so. The advertising description literally says "you never feel the coils" and that might very well be true if you add a feather bed topper or foam topper to the mattress before you lie on it. I can feel the coil springs in this on my back, stomach and side. I took a nap on this in the guest room yesterday and woke up feeling ok, but nowhere as refreshed as I do after a nap on our master bed. This mattress actually reminds me of the ones we had at summer camp in the 1970s and 1980s.

On the positive side of things, this does fit a traditional day bed frame perfectly (see the photos) and it fits our trundle bed slide out frame perfectly. It's also light weight enough and flexible enough for me to fold it in half and move it without any help. This is very good - when my nieces are visiting with their Mom, I can set the girls up in the living room with a real mattress and to watch tv, play games, build a fort etc and not have cushions and sleeping bags covering every inch of the floor. Basically, I will use the camp quality mattress for camp type activities, but not as a full time mattress.

description: is a durable innerspring mattress at an unbeatable value. Sturdy tempered steel wrapped coils and fiber layers separate the coils from the sleep surface so you can sleep undisturbed during the night. Perfect for guests, kid’s rooms, and even dorms. A sensible choice for quality and savings.

The 7-inch Innerspring Coil Mattress contains 312 sturdy tempered steel coils. One layer of soft foam is sewn into the quilted fabric cover. There are two polyester cushioning layers and two foam layers on top and beneath the coils, which provide a buffer, so you never feel the coils, even after years of use. For your convenience, this mattress is shipped compressed, rolled and vacuum sealed.
Our 7-inch innerspring mattress contains 312 sturdy tempered steel wrapped coils for quicker recovery. Also, tempered steel coils help maintain the shape of the mattress, no matter what body type.
Get it Right the First Time

It is also a good idea to know the size and the height of your mattress ahead of time to make sure you are ordering the correct size. Keep in mind that you should combine the height of your bed frame, foundation, or adjustable bed base with the height of your mattress to get a gauge of the how tall your sleep system will be.

A mattress that is roll-packed still retains its initial quality, as each will quickly recover and return to its original shape after coming out of the packaging.
